name: ruslan_v2
description: Buy the Polymarket 15m Up/Down favourite in the last minute (Ruslan's trigger) with distance, coin-count and session filters
status: frozen - do not change parameters, otherwise the forward test is no longer a forward test

markets.resolution: Up if Chainlink TWAP-60s at window end (finalPrice) >= Chainlink TWAP-60s at window start (priceToBeat), else Down

entry.side: the side (Up or Down) whose best ask is inside the price band - automatically the favourite
entry.order: market buy, fill-and-kill, limit price = max_fill_price
entry.if_price_above_limit: no fill, keep monitoring until monitor_to_s

filters.distance_definition: z = side * ln(expected final 60-s average / price to beat) / (sigma * sqrt(h))
filters.sigma_definition: sqrt(mean of squared 1-s log returns of the underlying over the last sigma_lookback_s seconds)
filters.h_definition: effective seconds left for the TWAP rule: h = V / 3600, V = nf^2 * a + (nf - 1) * nf * (2 * nf - 1) / 6, nf = not-yet-known seconds of the final minute, a = seconds until the first of them (about 20 s at 60 s before close)
filters.coin_rule: the third coin to trigger in the same window is skipped (causal)
filters.coin_rule_detail: triggers = base entry-rule signals (ask in the band and ask <= max_fill_price after fill_latency_s) of all coins in the window, ordered by time and counted BEFORE the distance and hour filters; the coin whose trigger is 3rd does not trade
filters.utc_hours_detail: hour of the entry moment; = windows closing 00:15-07:00 and 13:15-16:00 UTC (40 of 96 windows a day per coin)
filters.incident_note: backtest data hygiene (data/INCIDENTS.json); live: pause when Polymarket reports an incident or the book / Binance stream is stale

exit: none - hold to resolution, winning shares redeem at $1

price_feed.underlying: Binance spot 1-s closes BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT / SOLUSDT (proxy of the Chainlink price; change error ~0.3 bp median)
price_feed.price_to_beat_proxy: mean of Binance 1-s closes of bars opened in [start-61 s, start-2 s]; live: may use the official priceToBeat with the Binance-Chainlink basis
price_feed.book: Polymarket best bid/ask of the Up token; Down ask = 1 - Up bid

sizing_recommendation.note: not part of the backtested signal; backtest max drawdown 19% at 2%, 41% at 5% of the current balance
